rules.land: uniform random, dry, outside piers, > 2 m from footprints, slope <= 45 deg, all probes within 12 m in the 3DEP region (no feather band); source = 3DEP 1 m bilinear
rules.wet: uniform random water cells outside piers, all probes in the CUDEM region; source = CUDEM bilinear
rules.shore: 50 points evenly along the OSM water-polygon boundary inside the tile (45 m inset), profile along the normal from -40 m (land) to +40 m (water), 1 m step
